The first release of **Ghostdrop**: a fast, native drop-down (Quake-style) terminal for macOS with real tabs and global hotkeys, built on [libghostty](https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty) (the Ghostty 1.4.0 engine).

### Highlights

- **Global hotkey** (`` ctrl+` `` by default) shows and hides the terminal from anywhere. It needs no Accessibility permission.
- **Tabs.** `cmd+t` / `ctrl+shift+t` open a tab, `ctrl+tab`, `cmd+1…9` and `ctrl+page_up/down` switch, `cmd+shift+←/→` moves, three-finger swipe switches, middle-click closes.
- **Profiles.** A tab can run your login shell, an ssh host, tmux, or any command, each on its own key.
- **The Ghostty engine.** You get kitty keyboard and graphics protocols, synchronized output, OSC 8/52, truecolor, ligatures, IME and shell integration. Key encoding matches Ghostty.
- **Uses your Ghostty config** (theme, fonts, keybinds), with drop-down-only overrides in `~/.config/ghostdrop/config`.
- **Resize with the mouse.** Drag the free edge; the size is remembered. Double-click the edge to reset.
- **Built for speed.** Show takes about 10 ms, a tab switch about 0.1 ms, and a new tab 2–4 ms. CPU use is 0% while hidden.
- **AI-assisted setup.** Choose *Set Up with AI…* from the menu-bar icon to copy a prompt for your coding agent. The guide it points to is bundled at `Ghostdrop.app/Contents/Resources/AGENTS.md`.

### Install

1. Download **`Ghostdrop-0.1.0.dmg`** below, open it, and drag **Ghostdrop** onto **Applications**.
2. Open Ghostdrop from Applications. This build isn't notarized, so the first time macOS will refuse to open it. Go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.
3. Press `` ctrl+` ``. Ghostdrop lives in the menu bar; there's no Dock icon.
4. If you ssh to machines on your LAN, allow the **Local Network** prompt.
5. Optional: from the menu-bar icon, turn on **Launch at Login**, or choose **Set Up with AI…** to configure Ghostdrop.

If you use iTerm2's hotkey window or a Ghostty global keybind on the same key, turn that off or pick another `hotkey`.

### Requirements

- Apple Silicon Mac.
- macOS 13 Ventura or later. Developed and tested on macOS 26.

### Known limitations

- No split panes and no terminal inspector.
- No Intel build.
- The app is ad-hoc signed, not notarized.

### Verify the download

```sh
shasum -a 256 -c Ghostdrop-0.1.0.dmg.sha256
```
